mechanism_narrative: A sustained period of low federal funds rate (below 0.2%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 0.2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.0%, it signals an economic downturn that triggers policy stimulus, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 9.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) relative to their 3-month averages indicates a deepening economic contraction, triggering positive equity returns as investors anticipate stimulus.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and INDPRO does not produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-recession recovery phase, a housing market expansion (HOUST above 550) signals strengthening consumer demand, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where the regime is post-recession recovery and HOUST exceeds 550.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP level above 13000 (billions of chained 2017 dollars) signals sustained economic expansion, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 exceeds 13000.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI increase exceeding 2.5% signals inflationary pressures that lead to central bank rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL year-over-year change exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates a weak labor market under monetary stimulus, triggering positive equity returns as investors anticipate further policy support.
regime_hint: monetary stimulus in weak labor market
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and FEDFUNDS does not produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a manufacturing slowdown regime (INDPRO below 93.0), a decline in industrial production signals contractionary pressures that lead to positive S&P 500 returns as policymakers implement stimulus measures.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where the regime is manufacturing slowdown and INDPRO is below 93.0.
